text: what would such an ending mean for you, who are trying to save Shigurika, Nastashan, and everyone else? For the
leader of the organization who considers you the most formidable opponent, it would mean that

you, after experiencing long setbacks and failures, might end up walking the same path as her, valuing your own heart more than yours.  But if you actually take out the page, it will go berserk after receiving what it's been called.
